provenance.status: interim for docs/requests/E01.md R-E01-1 until the release carries a sourced observation policy
provenance.rule: A code or acquisition method without a row has no policy and is kept not assessed, never accepted (docs/tdd/E01.md section 3). Canonical and accepted wire units come from the pinned release's unit mapping (D12), not from this document.

minimum.basis: camera-quality.json pulse.band_hz.min 0.7 Hz (POS pass band, Wang 2017): the camera refuses a rate outside its band, never clips it; a method range, not a clinical threshold
minimum.to_be_set_by: clinical review (R-E01-1) and the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3)

maximum.basis: camera-quality.json pulse.band_hz.max 3.0 Hz (180 /min for a seated adult); a method range, not a clinical threshold
maximum.to_be_set_by: clinical review (R-E01-1) and the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3)

saturation_minimum.basis: the band edge: a camera rate at the edge of its analysis band is the value a clipped estimate would take

saturation_maximum.basis: the band edge: a camera rate at the edge of its analysis band is the value a clipped estimate would take

stuck_count.basis: team default: three identical camera readings in a row from one device

max_change_per_second.basis: team default: the whole band (138 /min) within one camera analysis window (camera-quality.json pulse.window_s 20 s)
